title: Public Profile/Menu runtime guard hardening
goal: Harden the existing public runtime boundary before any further Public/Profile split by making the bundle guard verify the Step 41/42 wiring and by covering QR/cart/favorites runtime routing with focused tests.

guardedContracts: profile-menu-focus-render-controller stays behind a dynamic import boundary
social-app keeps the Profile/Menu/Focus preload decision utility wired
social-app keeps the guarded early preload call
publicBusiness and publicMenu runtime slots continue to render the existing public profile renderer
publicBusiness and publicMenu runtime slots continue to preload the existing Profile/Menu/Focus renderer
QR menu access stays in the publicMenu runtime slot

risk: This step intentionally does not make the next runtime split. It reduces regression risk by failing the existing bundle guard if the current public runtime boundary or preload contract is silently broken.
